full_details: Love's Labour's Lost went to a half yard. You played Navarre. The journal does not hold the playing. After it the tiring-house door shut. Kemp wanted the road. John had the road in oats, mayors, and wages, and the case was carried, Kemp against. Last day is Saturday the twenty-sixth. The house opens again on Monday the twenty-fifth of August, and the question comes back on the seventeenth. At the Jackdaw a capon went between four. The glass was two shillings and sixpence. At nine you said the pain was a city. You came home after.
one_sentence: You played the afternoon, voted to keep the house open till the twenty-sixth, and gave Richard a glass at the Jackdaw.
title: Play on till the twenty-sixth, and a glass
